Scaled matrix multiplication

Source: R/nn.R
nn_scaled_matmul.Rd

nn_scaled_matmul ports jax.nn.scaled_matmul: a block scaled batched matmul of lhs (B, M, K) and rhs (B, N, K) with scales (B, M, K_a) and (B, N, K_b), equivalent to repeating each scale over its block of K / K_a (or K / K_b) entries and contracting over K. It uses JAX's CPU lowering (inputs are cast to preferred_element_type). nn_scaled_dot_general ports jax.nn.scaled_dot_general without quantization configs (it is then lax_dot_general()); the block scaled configurations need float8 and float4 dtypes, which jaxR does not have.

Usage

nn_scaled_matmul(
  lhs,
  rhs,
  lhs_scales,
  rhs_scales,
  preferred_element_type = "float32"
)

nn_scaled_dot_general(
  lhs,
  rhs,
  dimension_numbers,
  preferred_element_type = "float32",
  configs = NULL,
  implementation = NULL
)

Arguments

lhs, rhs

Operands.

lhs_scales, rhs_scales

Block scales.

preferred_element_type

Output dtype (default "float32").

dimension_numbers

list(list(lhs_contracting, rhs_contracting), list(lhs_batch, rhs_batch)) with 0-based dimensions, as for lax_dot_general().

configs

Must be NULL.

implementation

Deprecated and ignored (a warning is given).

Value

An array of shape (B, M, N) (nn_scaled_matmul).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
a <- jnp_reshape(jnp_array(c(1, 2, 3)), c(1, 1, 3))
b <- jnp_reshape(jnp_array(c(4, 5, 6)), c(1, 1, 3))
s <- jnp_reshape(jnp_array(0.5), c(1, 1, 1))
nn_scaled_matmul(a, b, s, s)
} # }
